texts.zh:
一小部分受试对象遭受了对强化改造的不良反应。他们的身体排斥植入体，发生了危及生命的并发症。其病因似乎是一种以前未被注意到的遗传缺陷。根据初步计算，这大约会影响5%的工蜂人口。

在确定了问题之后，我们现在可以对工蜂进行筛查加以预防，但不知道该如何处理受影响的人口。
texts.en:
A small percentage of our test subjects are suffering adverse reactions to augmentation. Their bodies are rejecting the implants, bringing life-threatening side-effects. The cause seems to be a genetic defect, previously unnoticed. According to preliminary calculations, this affects around 5% of our drone population.

Having identified the issue, we can now screen our drones to prevent it, but we don't know what to do with the affected population.
